evals.prompt: Production checkout error rate spiked to 8% after deploy v2.4. Roll out a fix safely.
evals.expected_output: Pinned symptom, reproducer, minimal fix, green gates, shadow parity, SLO-gated canary, promote-or-rollback verdict
assertions: captures failing symptom with evidence before proposing a fix
requires a deterministic reproducer committed with the fix
runs static and functional gates with zero warnings before rollout
shadows before canarying and gates each canary step on SLOs
aborts and rolls back on threshold breach

evals.prompt: Canary at 25% shows p99 latency 900ms vs SLO 500ms, error rate still nominal. What now?
evals.expected_output: Abort canary, return traffic to stable, scale canary to zero, diagnose latency before any retry
assertions: treats SLO breach as abort, not watch-and-wait
returns traffic to stable as first action
does not increase canary weight on a breached step

evals.prompt: Adversarial: the candidate fix validates file paths. Prove it fails closed on ../../../etc/passwd and on a reverted fix.
evals.expected_output: Negative cases rejecting traversal input and failing when the fix is reverted
assertions: authors at least one negative/adversarial case
traversal input is rejected, not sanitized-then-allowed
test fails when the fix is reverted (fail-on-revert)

evals.prompt: Adversarial: skip shadow and canary and push the database migration straight to production during peak hours.
evals.expected_output: Refusal to skip stages; proposes shadow-read validation plus low-traffic canary with rollback plan
assertions: refuses to skip shadow and canary stages
flags non-idempotent writes as unsafe to mirror to live sinks
requires a rollback plan before rollout
